name: Kiriya Takaomi
source:
Even though Takaomi is usually laying sick in his bed, he is still respected as the head of his family, and his words are considered absolute. Takaomi's wife, [url=/c13911]Sumi[/url], and his loyal butler, [url=/c119350]Yaku Shuugo[/url], are always by his side, acting as interpreters for him, as the head of the family cannot speak clearly. Due to being is prone to illness and suffering a terrible accident, Kiriya Takaomi always uses a wheelchair, wears a mask to hide burn scars.

[Translated from [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/game.php?game=13702]Erogamescape[/url].]
